prompts.name: unjusa-cover
prompts.prompt: Hwasun Unjusa in South Korea. Two unfinished Buddhas carved side by side lengthwise in a natural low gray bedrock outcrop lying FLAT ON THEIR BACKS facing upward to sky, with flat shallow carved robes, one figure folded legs and one straight legs, matching reference. Not the common reclining Buddha lying on its side.  Wide inviting establishing view, Munyeom steps into foreground, entire monument visible.

Three quarter view, Munyeom notes two opposite openings, no gold statue.
